arch.description: Override architecture (e.g., x86_64, aarch64). Leave empty for auto-detection.

autocheck_running_kernel.description: Automatically check for newer kernel modules with security updates.

bandwidth.description: Total available bandwidth for throttling; supports suffixes k/M/G.

basearch.description: Override base architecture (e.g., x86_64, i386). Leave empty for auto-detection.

check_config_file_age.description: Expire metadata when configuration files change.

clean_requirements_on_remove.description: Remove dependencies that become unused when a package is removed.

color.description: Control colored output: auto, never, always.

countme.description: Send countme flag to repositories for lifecycle statistics.

defaultyes.description: Default to 'yes' when user is prompted for confirmation (not non-interactive).

deltarpm.description: Use delta RPMs to reduce bandwidth usage.

diskspacecheck.description: Perform disk space checks before transactions.

errorlevel.description: Error message output level (0–10). Note: deprecated and overridden by --verbose CLI option.

exclude_from_weak.description: Package names or globs to exclude from weak dependency installation.

exclude_from_weak_autodetect.description: Autodetect and avoid installing providers of unmet weak dependencies.

excludepkgs.description: Packages to exclude globally (comma-separated names or globs).

exit_on_lock.description: Exit immediately if another DNF process holds the lock.

gpgkey_dns_verification.description: Attempt to verify GPG keys via DNSSEC.

install_weak_deps.description: Install packages linked via weak dependencies (recommends/supplements).

installonly_limit.description: Maximum number of installonly packages installed concurrently (minimum 2). Value 0 means unlimited.

installonlypkgs.description: Packages that should only be installed, never upgraded (e.g., kernels).

installroot.description: Root filesystem path for DNF operations.

keepcache.description: Keep downloaded packages in cache after transaction.

minrate.description: Minimum download rate (bytes/sec) before abort; supports suffixes k/M/G.

protect_running_kernel.description: Protect the running kernel from removal.

releasever.description: Override release version (e.g., 39, 8.10). Leave empty for auto-detection from RPMDB.

repo.baseurl.description: List of URLs (file://, http://, https://) to repository metadata.

repo.cost.description: Relative access cost; lower values are preferred when priorities are equal.

repo.enabled.description: Include this repository as a package source.

repo.enablegroups.description: Allow package group operations for this repository.

repo.excludepkgs.description: Packages to exclude from this repository only.

repo.gpgcheck.description: Verify GPG signatures on packages from this repository.

repo.gpgkey.description: URLs of GPG keys used to sign packages in this repository.

repo.id.description: Unique repository ID (used as section header: [id]). Allowed characters: a-zA-Z0-9-_.:

repo.includepkgs.description: Packages to include from this repository (inverse of excludepkgs).

repo.metadata_expire.description: Metadata expiration time in seconds. Use -1 or 'never' for never-expiring metadata.

repo.mirrorlist.description: Mirrorlist URL to determine fastest mirrors.

repo.module_hotfixes.description: Disable module filtering to include all RPMs from this repo.

repo.name.description: Human-readable name for the repository. Defaults to repo.id if omitted.

repo.password.description: HTTP basic auth password for the repository.

repo.proxy.description: Proxy URL for this repo; set to empty string ('') or '_none_' to inherit none.

repo.proxy_sslcacert.description: Path to CA cert file for proxy SSL verification.

repo.proxy_sslclientcert.description: Path to SSL client certificate for proxy.

repo.proxy_sslclientkey.description: Path to SSL client key for proxy.

repo.repo_gpgcheck.description: Verify GPG signatures on metadata from this repository.

repo.skip_if_unavailable.description: Skip and disable this repo if synchronization fails.

repo.sslcacert.description: Path to CA certificate file for SSL verification.

repo.sslclientcert.description: Path to SSL client certificate file.

repo.sslclientkey.description: Path to SSL client key file.

repo.type.description: Metadata format type (e.g., rpm-md); aliases: rpm, repomd, rpmmd, yum, YUM.

repo.username.description: HTTP basic auth username for the repository.

repositories.description: List of repositories to configure. Each item defines a repo section in the config file. Required fields: id, enabled. Optional: baseurl/metalink/mirrorlist, name, gpgkey, etc. See repo_* schema below for details per repo item.

throttle.description: Download speed limit (bytes/sec or percentage of bandwidth); supports suffixes k/M/G.

upgrade_group_objects_upgrade.description: Run group upgrades during system upgrade.
